actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own HiBob action with an HTTP request. The request uses your HiBob connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to create, e.g. Employee's work entry .

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to delete, e.g. Employee's work entry .

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to get, e.g. Employee .

actions.name: search_records
actions.title: Search records
actions.help: Search records that match all of your criteria.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to search, e.g. Employees .

actions.name: update_record
actions.title: Update record
actions.help: Update a record by ID. HiBob often returns no data after a successful update.

input.name: object
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select the object to update, e.g. Employee .
